calls.temporal_note: current-only facet on marketdata build 06e115d7+: the server refuses end_date because it cannot reconstruct a point-in-time snapshot, and fails the call rather than serving live data as if it were dated. The read is therefore CURRENT (capture instant), not as-of $refdate; the article must date it as such. Point-in-time bounding stays on the bar facets, which support it. The 'quote' facet was removed: on build 06e115d7 it returns completed_without_data cells for identified symbols (server-side cell-attribution defect), and a live quote must never govern a published percentage move — certified bars from focus_bars do that.

'unusual_options' moved to a detached wave: marketdata reports a symbol with NO unusual flow as a completed_without_data cell rather than an empty success, so a legitimate absence failed the governing call. Unusual flow colours a name, it never governs a level, a move or a publication decision.
